name: Terminal Cut-Vertex Obstruction of Order 1158
definition: Translate the certified 289-concept rooted factor $B=(G\cup\{91\})\setminus\{61,125,93\}$ by its root 29 to obtain $C$. Use repairing tips $\alpha=128$ and $\delta=290$, form their paired square rooted factor $Y$, and glue $Y$ at its root to a disjoint copy of $C$.
parameters: $|Y|=870$ in dimension 14; the final class has 1158 concepts, isometric dimension 26, and VC dimension four.
properties: The final family is an ample corner-descent-terminal pc-minimal obstruction to dismantlable ampleness. It has one cut vertex, exactly two degree-four corners, root degree five, and minimum degree four, so it is its own graph three-core. Deleting the cut vertex leaves components of orders 869 and 288. Either corner deletion has the cornerless 577-concept double $C\vee C$ as a proper minor.
